description: WHAT: SERP title/description/URL slice for one marketing URL. Reads /llms-serp-{locale}.txt first (locale from URL prefix or args.locale), then falls back to full /llms-serp.txt. path or url required in practice. If path is not http(s), it is turned into www(locale, path). No match → serp_not_found. RETURNS matchContext (~200 chars before + 400 after) + source. Not a Google API.

locale.description: HTML locale for canonicalUrl and path prefixes. de = default, URLs have no prefix (https://www.ikeytz.com/preise). en|fr|ru|fa|ar|tr = prefix /{locale}/ (https://www.ikeytz.com/en/preise). Omit or empty = de. Does not change prices, phone numbers, or legal German names. Not a maps.ikeytz.com locale (maps is German-only).

path.description: Site path (/preise) or used with locale to build the www URL to find in llms-serp.txt.

url.description: If this starts with http, it is used as the search needle instead of path.

name: get_serp_snippet
title: Get Serp Snippet
